# AliExpress

> > AliExpress is a global online retail marketplace connecting international buyers with sellers, offering wholesale and retail products across diverse categories.

AliExpress operates as a major cross-border ecommerce platform, enabling consumers and businesses worldwide to purchase products directly from suppliers. The platform supports both individual retail purchases and bulk B2B wholesale transactions.

## Key Topics

- AliExpress
- wholesale
- ecommerce
- marketplace
- shopping-platform
- B2B
- bulk purchasing
- cross-border commerce
- online retail
- international shipping

## Wholesale & B2B

- [Wholesale Marketplace](https://www.aliexpress.com/wholesale.html): AliExpress wholesale marketplace for bulk purchasing and B2B ecommerce
